description: This file is a shell script designed for testing Git's pack-objects command with various options such as --stdin-packs, --filter, --revs, and other features related to Git packing mechanism. It includes setup routines, multiple test cases, and helper functions for verifying behavior of packing objects using stdin packs, handling exclusions, deltas, and missing objects.

methods.name: packed_objects
methods.description: Reads the index of a pack file, extracts object IDs, sorts and returns them.

methods.name: objects_in_packs
methods.description: Reads multiple pack indexes, extracts object IDs, sorts and returns them.

methods.name: stdin_packs__follow_with_only
methods.description: Sets up a minimal repository, creates commits, packs objects, and tests the --stdin-packs=follow behavior with only specified commits.
